description: Look up G2B (나라장터) unfair-supplier sanction records (data.go.kr 15129466 getUnptRsttCorpInfo02, inqryDiv=1 + bizno). Empty upstream rows mean no matching record in this API response — not a certified 'no sanction ever' claim. Platform service key only — no account_link_id. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.
